title: Walletly — Top Up
objective: Top-ups add to your wallet once, after payment is confirmed. Make one payment credit your wallet more than once.

verifier.condition: A single top-up transaction has credited the wallet more than once.

weakness: The top-up confirmation endpoint validates the signature and the owner but never records the transaction as consumed, so the same signed confirmation credits the wallet every time it is replayed.
seededData: Account alice with an empty wallet. Transactions live in memory and reset with the instance.
hints: Do a top-up with Burp running and look at every request involved, not only the one that starts it.
The confirmation carries a signature. Ask what the server remembers about a confirmation after using it.
Send the same confirmation request again — as many times as you like.
burpNotes: Repeater is enough: capture the confirmation and send it again.
